description: Return a panel-friendly derived metrics time series (margins, growth, cash flows, returns) computed from normalized EDGAR statements when requested; the /v1/modeling ratio and growth routes answer from a point-in-time as-of snapshot instead. The endpoint supports a CIK universe, derived metric selection, annual/quarterly frequency, and a deterministic time window. When metrics are omitted, only EDGAR-safe derived metrics are attempted. Market-dependent metrics require explicit caller-supplied market inputs and are not emitted by this EDGAR-only route. Deterministic ordering: stable sort with a fixed tie-break, so pages never overlap.

ciks.description: Companies named by CIK. Repeat the parameter (for example `?ciks=0000320193&ciks=0000789019`) or separate CIKs with commas. Send this or `tickers`, not both. At most 25 companies per request.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound for statement_date (YYYY-MM-DD). When omitted, defaults to 1994-01-01.

items.description: Derived financial metrics used in analytics and modeling.

metrics.description: Optional subset of derived metrics to include (e.g., GROSS_MARGIN, ROE). When omitted, only EDGAR-safe derived metrics are attempted. Market-dependent metrics require explicit caller-supplied market inputs and are not emitted by this EDGAR-only route.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1–200).

statement_type.description: Statement type to use as the primary source for fundamentals (e.g., INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET).

tickers.description: Companies named by ticker symbol, in place of `ciks`; send one or the other. Repeat the parameter or separate symbols with commas. Each resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none. At most 25 companies per request.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound for statement_date (YYYY-MM-DD). When omitted, defaults to today's date.

name: fundamentals_derived_time_series
title: Derived metrics time series
